verdict.rationale: Adyen documents that its terminals are PCI PTS 6 certified and PCI-compliant, which supports the certified-reader part of the story. Nothing in the evidence covers end-to-end encryption of card data, how a terminal integration reduces the developer's PCI scope, or guidance on remaining obligations. Missing for 10: documented end-to-end/point-to-point encryption keeping card data out of the merchant's systems, explicit PCI scope-reduction claims, vendor guidance on remaining merchant PCI obligations (e.g. SAQ type), independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can keep my PCI scope minimal because card data is captured end-to-end by certified readers and vendor systems, with vendor guidance on my remaining obligations

citations.quote: Get started fast with a full range of PCI PTS 6 certified terminals.
Lets you choose from a wide range of fully-certified and PCI-compliant Adyen payment terminals.
